# Novel Creator 0.10.4 issue retrospective resources

The workflow files and `novel-retro.skill.md` preserve the notebook
resources from [v0.10.4](https://github.com/bjarkig82/novel-creator/tree/v0.10.4)
(commit `3a6807c3c40ca841f486e98296420af434b74de1`).
`root-issue-retro.md` preserves the marked issue retrospective block from
